exposure: maternal SARS-CoV-2 infection during pregnancy (in-utero exposure)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 137 children, 69 exposed in-utero to maternal SARS-CoV-2 infection and 68 unexposed controls, whose mothers were unvaccinated at the time of cohort inclusion.
finding: In-utero SARS-CoV-2 exposure was associated with neurodevelopmental impairment during the first year of life, with a higher prevalence of delay in exposed children compared to controls.
